stories.title: Vollering soleert week na wereldtitel naar tweede EK-goud op rij

en.title: Vollering solos to second consecutive European Championship gold a week after world title
en.summary: Demi Vollering won the European cycling championship title a week after claiming the world championship. The Dutch rider demonstrated superior strength throughout the race in Slovenia.

stories.title: Demi Vollering rijdt week na wereldtitel ook overtuigend naar goud bij EK

en.title: Demi Vollering convincingly rides to gold at European Championship a week after world title
en.summary: Demi Vollering secured the European cycling championship title one week following her world championship victory. The defending champion from the Netherlands dominated the competition in Slovenia with an extended solo effort.

stories.title: Man vindt bijna 130.000 dollar die monteur bij geldautomaat in VS is vergeten

en.title: Man finds nearly 130,000 dollars left by technician at ATM in United States
en.summary: A 37-year-old man discovered a bag containing approximately 128,514 dollars at an automated teller machine in Texas. The funds had been accidentally left behind by a maintenance worker after servicing the machine.

stories.title: Omroep EO stopt na ruim 25 jaar met Het Familiediner

en.title: Broadcaster EO ends Het Familiediner after over 25 years
en.summary: The Evangelical Broadcaster is discontinuing the television program Het Familiediner after more than two decades on air. One final season will air, during which families can still apply to participate in the show that reunites estranged relatives.

stories.title: Britse politie verijdelt aanslag op Joodse gemeenschap van Manchester, twee Iraniërs opgepakt

en.title: British police foil attack on Jewish community of Manchester, two Iranians arrested
en.summary: British police stopped a planned attack targeting Manchester's Jewish community and arrested two Iranian nationals in connection with the thwarted plot.

stories.title: Identiteit van copiloot flydubai bekend, viel piloot aan met bijl

en.title: Identity of flydubai copilot revealed, attacked pilot with axe
en.summary: A flydubai copilot identified as Hammam Al Hammami attacked the pilot with an axe in the cockpit during a flight on Wednesday, according to United Arab Emirates authorities.

stories.title: Man vindt tas met 128.514 dollar bij geldautomaat in VS

en.title: Man finds bag with 128,514 dollars at ATM in United States
en.summary: A Texas man discovered a bag containing over 128,000 dollars at an automated teller machine and contacted police after attempting to locate the owner.

stories.title: Britse OM klaagt Iraniërs aan voor voorbereiden aanslag op synagoge in Manchester

en.title: British prosecutors charge two Iranians with preparing attack on synagogue in Manchester
en.summary: British prosecutors charged two Iranian men aged 35 and 36 with preparing a bomb attack on a Manchester synagogue scheduled for Yom Kippur on September 20.

stories.title: Copiloot Flydubai viel gezagvoerder aan met bijl, ook naam bekend

en.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, identity also revealed
en.summary: A Flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain of a flight between Dubai and Tel Aviv using an axe this week. The UAE's Public Prosecution has characterized the incident as a terrorist attack.

stories.title: 'Ik zag met mijn eigen ogen hoe hij hem zonder te stoppen neerstak.' Wat er gebeurde aan boord van de FlyDubai-vlucht in acht video's

en.title: "I saw with my own eyes how he stabbed him without stopping." What happened aboard the FlyDubai flight in eight videos
en.summary: Flight FZ 1073 was taken over by a pilot of Omani nationality on September 30th. Eight videos document events that occurred inside the aircraft.

stories.title: Het Familiediner stopt na ruim 25 jaar en werkt aan laatste seizoen

en.title: The Family Dinner ends after more than 25 years and works on final season
en.summary: The Family Dinner, a Dutch television program that has run for over 25 years, will conclude. People can still apply to participate in its final season.

stories.title: Auto rijdt in op Australische rugbyfans, ook kinderen onder de tien gewonden

en.title: Car drives into Australian rugby fans, ten injured including children
en.summary: Ten people were injured when a vehicle struck a crowd in Newcastle, Australia. A 67-year-old man and a 5-year-old girl are in critical condition.
